theme_and_context.target_audience: Readers seeking inspiration and personal connection

rules.headings: NEVER use bold/black weights for Cormorant Garamond; stick to regular/medium for an editorial, elegant feel. High contrast in sizes.
rules.alignment: Prioritize left-alignment for text blocks. Asymmetry creates an editorial vibe.

spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Bento / Editorial Asymmetry. Max-width containers with offset internal grid. Use 12-column grid but span unevenly (e.g., 7 cols for text, 4 cols for images).
spacing_and_layout.spacing_scale: Extremely generous. Sections should be padded with py-24 or py-32. Elements gap-12 or gap-16.
spacing_and_layout.surfaces: Avoid generic cards. Use flat rectangles or subtle 1px borders (border-[#DCD3C6]) with NO shadows. Let negative space separate elements instead of boxes.

patterns.hero_reveal: Masked line-by-line text reveal for the tagline. Each line translates up from y: 100% with a slight delay.
patterns.scroll_reveals: Staggered fade-up and subtle Y-offset on scroll using Framer Motion (whileInView).
patterns.book_hover: Subtle 3D tilt on hover for the featured book cover, mapped to mouse position (use framer-motion useTransform or similar).
patterns.marquee: One very slow, continuous editorial marquee (e.g., react-fast-marquee or CSS infinite translate) using the Serif font, displaying praise or book themes.
patterns.smooth_scroll: Lenis is MANDATORY to give weight and momentum to the page.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped or slightly rounded (rounded-full or rounded-md). Solid background in Accent color (#C86F43) with White text. Hover states should scale up slightly and darken.
components.navigation: Sticky top bar, solid background (#F7F5F0) or subtle blur, thin bottom border. Clean, minimal links.
components.testimonials: Editorial layout. Large quote mark, serif font for the quote itself, sans-serif for the attribution.
components.forms: Minimalist form fields. Bottom-border only (underlined input) rather than fully boxed fields, to match the elegant vibe.

image_urls.description: Warm, atmospheric book setup for the hero or book showcase if actual cover asset is missing.
Warm lit, thoughtful portrait for the Author section.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure Deep Espresso text on Linen backgrounds meets 4.5:1 ratio.
accessibility_and_testing.data_testid: Apply data-testid to all interactive and structural components (e.g., 'hero-cta-button', 'author-section', 'contact-form-submit').

styling_rules: DO NOT use generic Shadcn cards with heavy borders/shadows. Strip Shadcn components to be flat, elegant, and seamless.
NEVER center everything. Tension and visual interest come from asymmetry and grid offsets.
NEVER use generic gradients (no purple/blue). Stick to the warm, matte color palette.
Do NOT use pure #000000 or #FFFFFF. Use the defined palette.
Do NOT use 'inter' or generic sans for headings. Apply Cormorant Garamond.
implementation_details: Install and set up '@studio-freight/react-lenis' for smooth scrolling.
Install and use 'framer-motion' for staggered text reveals (split text by line, overflow hidden on wrapper, translate Y up).
Install 'react-fast-marquee' for the slow editorial strip.
Use '.js' / '.jsx' extensions since the project is standard JS (React), not TS.
instructions_to_main_agent.UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this! Create depth, use left-aligned typography, avoid centered templates, and implement staggered entry animations. No placeholders for images—use the provided URLs. DO NOT add `transition: all` in CSS. No AI emojis. Add data-testid to key elements. Do NOT use fully transparent backgrounds behind headers.
